# The name each application a fresh machine ships gives itself: the
# untranslated Name= of the desktop entry its package exports, one line each,
# its identifier, a tab, and that name.
#
# GENERATED. Do not edit by hand. These names are not ours and cannot be read
# off this repository: alo-shipping installs each application at first boot,
# so they exist only in the package. `.github/workflows/shipped-names.yml`
# installs every application in shipped.toml and runs
#   alo-shipped-names <the folders their entries are exported to>
# which prints what this file should hold and fails when it holds anything
# else. It never writes this file: a person copies what it printed.
#
org.mozilla.firefox	Firefox
org.kde.dolphin	Dolphin
org.kde.ark	Ark
org.gnome.TextEditor	Text Editor
org.gnome.Loupe	Image Viewer
org.gnome.Papers	Document Viewer
app.devsuite.Ptyxis	Ptyxis
com.vscodium.codium	VSCodium
